info.title: v2.global_product.init_tier_variation
info.description: Only for China mainland sellers and Korean sellers. If you only define color, it is one tier, if you define color and size, it is two tier. Support two tier structures at most. This API can change no tier to one tier, no tier to two tier, one tier to two tier, two tier to one tier, one tier to no tier, two tier to no tier. Please create variants after an interval of 5 seconds after creating an item, as there may be a delay.

post.description: Only for China mainland sellers and Korean sellers. If you only define color, it is one tier, if you define color and size, it is two tier. Support two tier structures at most. This API can change no tier to one tier, no tier to two tier, one tier to two tier, two tier to one tier, one tier to no tier, two tier to no tier. Please create variants after an interval of 5 seconds after creating an item, as there may be a delay.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: days_to_ship
parameters.description: Days to ship. Please get the days_to_ship range from the get_dts_limit API.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: The dimension of this global model. If don't set the dimension of this global model, will use the dimension of global item by default.

parameters.name: global_item_id
parameters.description: ID of global item.

parameters.name: global_model
parameters.description: Model info list, model number at most 50

parameters.name: global_model_sku
parameters.description: Sku of global model. model_sku length information needs to be no more than 100 characters.

parameters.name: image_id
parameters.description: standardise tier variation option image ID

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: location_id of stock, if the merchant has 3PF shop, the location_id cannot be empty, can use the get_merchant_warehouse_location_list API to obtain the location_id list of the merchant, if the merchant does not have 3PF shop (only has normal CBSC shop), the location_id can be empty

parameters.name: merchant_id
parameters.description: Shopee’s unique identifier for a merchant. Required for all merchant level requests(CB CNSC user calling global product related APIs).

parameters.name: original_price
parameters.description: Original price of global model.

parameters.name: package_height
parameters.description: The height of package for this global model, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: package_length
parameters.description: The length of package for this global model, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: package_width
parameters.description: The width of package for this global model, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: pre_order
parameters.description: Pre-order information of this global model. Notes: If don't set the DTS of this global model, will use the DTS of the global item by default.

parameters.name: seller_stock
parameters.description: seller_stock of global item

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, merchant_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: standardise_tier_variation
parameters.description: There is at least one standardise_tier_variation and tier_variation. If you want to update one tier/two tier to no tier, can just pass the tier_variation and standardise_tier_variation as [], and pass the global_model >> tier_index as [], meanwhile pass the original_price, seller_stock, etc., to set the price and stock for the modified product with no tier structure.

parameters.name: stock
parameters.description: stock

parameters.name: tier_index
parameters.description: Tier index of global model. Index starts from 0. If you want to update one tier/two tier to no tier, can just pass the tier_variation and standardise_tier_variation as [], and pass the global_model >> tier_index as [], meanwhile pass the original_price, seller_stock, etc., to set the price and stock for the modified product with no tier structure.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: variation_group_id
parameters.description: standardise tier variation group ID

parameters.name: variation_id
parameters.description: standardise tier variation ID

parameters.name: variation_name
parameters.description: standardise tier variation name

parameters.name: variation_option_id
parameters.description: standardise tier variation option ID

parameters.name: variation_option_list
parameters.description: standardise tier variation option list

parameters.name: variation_option_name
parameters.description: standardise tier variation option value

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: The weight of this global model, the unit is KG. If don't set the weight of this global model, will use the weight of global item by default. If set the dimension of this global model, them must set the weight of this global model.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/global_product/init_tier_variation?access_token=access_token&merchant_id=merchant_id&partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "global_item_id": 22001469,
    "global_model": [
        {
            "dimension": {
                "package_height": 11,
                "package_length": 11,
                "package_width": 11
            },
            "global_model_sku": "sku",
            "original_price": 12.34,
            "pre_order": {
                "days_to_ship": 2
            },
            "seller_stock": [
                {
                    "location_id": "CNZ",
                    "stock": 100
                }
            ],
            "tier_index": [
                0,
                1
            ],
            "weight": 1.1
        }
    ],
    "standardise_tier_variation": [
        {
            "variation_group_id": 0,
            "variation_id": 0,
            "variation_name": "-",
            "variation_option_list": [
                {
                    "image_id": "-",
                    "variation_option_id": 0,
                    "variation_option_name": "-"
                }
            ]
        }
    ],
    "tier_variation": [
        {
            "name": "tier 1",
            "option_list": [
                {
                    "image": {
                        "image_id": "c54265d475b85e00ffb2404585e32b6f"
                    },
                    "option": "opt"
                }
            ]
        }
    ]
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
